<p align="center"><strong>First seal broken. Unlock the attic.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The spider sinks into the wood. A brass key rests inside on an orange ribbon, cold enough to hurt. When you lift it, the voice stops.</p>

<p align="center">The chest is empty now. Under the lid someone has carved: &quot;A guest may leave. A name may not.&quot; Upstairs, a bell rings once.</p>
